as_told.title: Kodak-company engineer tried to power up the Aztec craft

plain: This story is about a craft said to have crashed near Aztec, New Mexico, in March 1948 and to have been taken to Wright Field, a military airfield. A podcast host named Jesse Michels says that a firsthand witness claimed to have worked on that craft at Wright Field, and the story goes that when it was powered up it became see-through. Scott Ramsay, an author who wrote a book about the Aztec crash, says an engineer connected to the camera company Eastman Kodak contacted him and said he was pretty sure it was the craft he had worked on after reading Ramsay's book. People tell it because, if true, it would mean the military recovered a working craft that was not made by humans.
